note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for the Delaware 153rd General Assembly (LegiScan 2163). Every person in the session file has an entry, so a null is a reviewed decision rather than a gap the resolver has yet to reach. Seats come from LegiScan's `district` field, which agrees with Delaware's own roster throughout this session; `role` is not read anywhere, because LegiScan has been seen to contradict itself between the two. Delaware's roster in this database is partial by design: all 11 Senate districts on the 2026 ballot are covered, but only 8 of the 41 House districts, so most nulls are members whose district simply has no candidate rows yet. A roster campaign is filling those in, and re-running the import after it lands adds the new members without duplicating anything.
